text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Are we really gonna use all this stuff?
Like the cheering fans, and the fishing rod...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! You use those muscles to slooowly and steaaadily...
acclimate to the athletic movements!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket has experience in all kinds of sports, and if she says so, let's give it a try for now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you today, Ticket Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...My aim is completely shot.
I'm barely even grazing the target.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Just hitting it at all is amazing enough!!
Taishin, you're overflowing with pure ambition!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, stop exaggerating every single thing, you idiot.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Uuuuuuuu, Umadacchi!" *hop!*
"Uuuuuuuu, Umadacchi!" *hop!*

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, Hayahideee!!
The key to the long jump is the approach rhythm!
Next up is the 'hop'—let's try actually jumping!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a break soon, you two!
I'll head to the storage room to pick out the next tools~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...She says that, but she still hasn't come back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, maybe they're just getting carried away.
I just hope they haven't run out of steam in the storage room—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—All right! Got all the tools together!
Now, all that's left is...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Hayahide always—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"'Solving the problem isn't the finish line.
Look at your answer objectively and review it for any mistakes.'"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's it! Let's do a maintenance check on the equipment!
And also—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"‘Before queuing multiplayer, max limit-break the tank――
...Before battle, level up the character with the shield.’"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I need to rephrase technical terms into easy-to-understand words! Gotta be careful when explaining the equipment.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh...
I really want to return the favor for everything those two do for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy
on my way to the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaaa!
Next up, we're doing diving training with this!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, putting it that way makes it sound like a joke, but... she put a lot of thought into this routine. As her Trainer, I will trust her and follow her lead.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So, how am I actually supposed to use this?
............Ti... Ticket Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! You twoooo...!
choice_data_list: Do you mind if I watch for reference?
They're a really good Trainer, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! You twoooo...!
choice_data_list: Do you mind if I watch for reference?
They're a really good Trainer, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Reaching for the dream I've longed for!
Ahead of everyone else! An earnest dash!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Singing together while waving our folding fans with complete devotion, we trained our lung capacity!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Uwaaaaaaaahhhh!!! I'm zo haaaappyyyy!!!
Thaaank youuuuu~~~~~!!!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, jeez, quit making a fuss over everything, idiot!
